candidates.description: This vector represents cognitive capabilities, artificial intelligence, and information processing.
This vector represents concepts related to providing explanations, reasoning, and addressing questions or interpretations.
This vector activates on technical terms related to data processing, machine learning architecture, and computational components.
This feature vector activates on active transitive verbs denoting intentional actions, operations, and strategic interventions.
This feature vector represents the concepts of harm, safety, risk, and their associated impacts or protective measures.
This vector represents the concept of estimating, predicting, or calculating future or unknown values.
This vector represents concepts related to computation, mathematics, and algorithmic processing.
These tokens represent mathematical, algorithmic, and analytical methods used in computational modeling and data processing.
These tokens function as degree adverbs and intensifiers that modify the extent, scale, or intensity of adjectives, verbs, or other adverbs.
This vector represents the concept of progress, growth, and the ongoing process of development or improvement.
